prompt: When the maker of the third-party console title "ActRaiser", merged with the makers of the console title "Chrono Trigger", what percentage of the company did the makers of "ActRaiser" make up?
answer:
The answer is **about 60%**.

“ActRaiser” was made by **Quintet** but published by **Enix**, while “Chrono Trigger” was associated with **Square**. When **Enix and Square merged in 2003** to form Square Enix, Enix’s shareholders held approximately **60%** of the combined company, with Square’s holding about 40%.
